memory_candidates.content: In this Lean repo a clause stated at window times against a computed Finset cannot be read at an arbitrary time unless the wrap-faithfulness demand is indexed by residue: a single equation at one reference time constrains only one residue class mod the period, and the two obvious derivations of the other classes both fail (backward reachability satisfies the shifted equation but is not contained in the live set there; the live set there satisfies no equation the single-residue demand implies).

Mixing two definitionally-equal-but-syntactically-different types in a Lean 4 rw motive (here the frame carrier `(G.frame h).WorldState` versus `ℤ × Fin n`) produces an 'Application type mismatch ... expected to have type' note and then leaves a goal that prints as `X = X` unsolved. Keep every intermediate equation ascribed at one of the two types and hand the result over by `exact`, which checks defeq. Relatedly, `omega` fails on a binder whose type is `F.Duration.carrier` rather than syntactically `Int`: prove the pointwise statement over `v : Int` first.

When a Lean truth lemma must relate a semantic clause to a label, defining the label by a recursion that never mentions truth (reading the structure's own data by fiat at the state shapes, and taking the existential form of the temporal operators) makes the until/since cases a direct transfer under the induction hypotheses and removes the circularity a truth-based labelling creates, because agreement-on-state for the true type IS the semantic correctness the local-coherence lemma takes as a hypothesis.
